message: the closure captures `s`, which lives in region `@s`, and is stored into the field `f` of a value, which lives in region `@r`
help: MM-RGN-3 for a closure: a lambda's region is the region it is created in AND the region of everything it captures, because its record holds a reference to each capture. It may be stored only where every capture outlives the place. Capture a copy made in the place's region, or stop capturing the short-lived value

message: a value allocated in this function's own region is stored into the field `f` of a value, which lives in region `@r`
help: MM-RGN-3 (docs/memory-model-v2-design.md): a value may be stored only into a place its own region OUTLIVES, because the place is still readable after the value's region has been reclaimed. A region named in a signature (`@r`) outlives the function's own region and is unordered against another name; the function's own region is its caller's. Keep the value in the region of the place it is stored into - allocate it there, or copy it there - or widen the place's annotation to the value's region
